description_en: Modifies the information about multiple images at a time. After you upload images to ApsaraVideo VOD, you can call this operation to update their titles, descriptions, tags, and categories at a time based on the IDs of the images
description_zh: 图片上传到视频点播后，可以调用本接口通过图片ID批量修改图片的标题、描述、标签和分类信息
name: UpdateImageInfos

parameters.description_en:
The new information about the one or more images. You can modify the information about up to 20 images at a time. For more information about the parameter structure, see the **UpdateContent** section.

>  The values of the nested parameters Title, Description, and Tags under the UpdateContent parameter cannot contain emoticons.
parameters.description_zh:
更新内容。一次最多支持修改20个图片的信息。参数结构参考下表**更新内容UpdateContent**。

> - Title、Description、Tags更新内容中不能包含表情符。
>- 传入参数则更新相应字段，否则相应字段不会被覆盖或更新。
